name: comb_materials
rows: Spring steel strip 0.5 mm, laser cut
Spring steel strip 0.3 mm, laser cut

name: note_angle_zero
expr: (0.5 - slots / 2) * slot_angle + 90 deg - pin_half_angle - release_angle - crank_angle / crank_ratio

name: wheel_start_radius_safe
expr: if(abs(wheel_start_radius - drum_radius) < 0.06 mm, wheel_start_radius + 0.12 mm, wheel_start_radius)

name: wheel_mid_radius_safe
expr: if(abs(wheel_mid_radius - drum_radius) < 0.06 mm, wheel_mid_radius + 0.12 mm, wheel_mid_radius)

name: pinion_spin
expr: 90 deg * crank_ratio + 270 deg - 180 deg / pinion_teeth + crank_ratio * drum_park + crank_angle

name: axle_height
expr: max(floor_thickness + 2 mm + wheel_tip_radius, crank_radius + knob_radius + 3 mm, floor_thickness + 2 mm + comb_depth * sin(comb_tilt))

name: pawl_phi
expr: 180 deg - mod((270 deg + drum_park) / tooth_angle - 0.5 + 1000, 1) * tooth_angle

tune
label: Tune
description: The melody the drum plays once per turn (three old tunes, free to use).

name: tempo
label: Tempo
description: Quarter notes a minute. It sets how fast to turn the crank.

name: crank_angle
label: Turn the crank
description: Drag it: the drum turns and the pins pass the comb, and the far end of the slider is one play of the tune. Turn the real crank clockwise only, facing the crank: a pawl on the drum gear stops a backward turn within one tooth.

name: drum_diameter
label: Drum diameter
description: The pins' circle. The smallest follows from the tune: two pins on one tooth must leave the tooth time to come back. A larger drum has more room.

name: crank_ratio
label: Crank turns per tune
description: How many turns of the crank play the tune once: the gear pair. More turns means a slower, steadier crank and a finer step of the pawl that stops a backward turn; the least follows from that, the most from the drum diameter (the gear teeth stay printable).

name: comb_material
label: Comb
description: What the tuned teeth are made of. Spring steel laser cut rings; a printed comb plays the right notes for a moment and then dies away (see the page).

name: tooth_pitch
label: Tooth spacing
description: Centre to centre of the teeth along the drum. Wider teeth are easier to print and align; the comb and the drum follow.

name: tooth_lift
label: Pluck strength
description: How far a pin lifts a tooth before it lets go: louder and harder on the teeth as it grows. The comb's angle follows. The top is what the comb can take at its highest note.

name: show
label: Show
description: The box as it plays, or the printed parts on the bed in their print orientation (export this as 3MF).

title: Music box
description: A printable cylinder music box. Pick a tune, a drum size, a comb (spring steel to laser cut, or printed) and a tempo: the pins, the tuned teeth, the gears and the case follow, and Turn the crank plays it by turning the drum. To make it: with Show on Print layout, export the model as 3MF for the printer; with Show on Assembled, export the named set Comb flat pattern as DXF or SVG for the laser shop when the comb is steel. Turn the crank clockwise only.
